remarks: Discover your Dream Home at 55 Bayne Street, where spaciousness meets seclusion in Norwalk's coveted Cranbury neighborhood. Allow 55 Bayne Street to welcome you. Located just minutes from the Merritt Parkway, I-95, Cranbury Park, shopping, and dining, this home offers the perfect balance of accessibility and tranquility. Move in and start enjoying everything 55 Bayne Street has to offer from day one. Come see why this remarkable home should be the next chapter in your story.
